title: Talking to Robots: A Practical Examination of Speech Foundation Models for HRI Applications

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) performance by measuring Word Error Rate (WER) on datasets featuring speech from individuals with speech impairments or medical conditions, such as cleft lip and palate, dementia, cerebral palsy, and ALS.
Evaluating ASR performance by measuring Word Error Rate (WER) on datasets containing speech from children and elderly speakers compared to standard benchmarks.
Evaluating ASR performance by measuring Word Error Rate (WER) on datasets featuring accented speech from non-native English speakers, Nigerian English speakers, and diverse native language speakers.
